revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - lin10 σταφυλὰ̣ς̣ (unbracket and dot ὰ) has been confirmed on the original by Ben Henry. || lin17 Ἡρακλεοπ(ολίτου) is good. || lin1 end => Τ[.9] <:[τῇ]=PN W.B. Henry (from autopsy)|ed|τ[ῆι]:>
Submit - Two corrections, one new reading.

Commit - Corrections in l. 2 ἀ̣δελφῇ => ἀ̣δελφῆι (the right foot of the eta is visible); l. 10 στ ̣ ̣ ̣λ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣=> σταφυλ[ὰ]ς̣ [ca.3] (obviously a request to bring/send grapes when he/someone comes. Having said that I'm not at all sure about σ̣ε̣ ἀ̣σ̣π̣άζ̣ε̣τ̣α̣ι̣ in l. 9); in l. 17 Ἡρακλ(έους) πόλ(εως) => Ἡρακλεοπ(ολίτου), which would additionally validate the reading ἐπισκ(έπτου), cf. e.g. P.Brem.3: ἐπισκέπταις τοῦ αὐτοῦ νομοῦ.

Submit - Changed regularized form ἔσοπτρον instead of εἴσοπτρον at lin 4, because ἔσοπτρον is the standard form of the word as it occurs in papyri (see e.g. BGU 6 1300, P. Hamb. 3 223, P.Oxy 6 978 P.Oxy 12 1449 and I. Bonati-N. Reggiani, Mirrors of women, mirrors of words: the mirror in the Greek papyri, in "Mirrors and Mirroring from Antiquity to the Early Modern period". ed by M. Gerolemou and L. Diamantopoulou, London, 2019, 59-71). Added the acute accent to the word ὄσυπτρον at lin 4.
